context: Select the correct alternative and fill in the blanks in the following statements.
stem: If a transversal intersects two parallel lines then the sum of interior angles on the same side of the transversal is ............
_why: This is the interior angle theorem: when two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, the interior angles on either side of it are supplementary, so their sum is 180 degrees.

subtopic: Pairs of Angles Formed by a Transversal
context: Select the correct alternative and fill in the blanks in the following statements.
stem: The number of angles formed by a transversal of two lines is ............
_why: A transversal meets each of the two lines at one point, and four angles are formed at each such point, so \(4 \times 2 = 8\) angles in all. Option B counts only one intersection.

context: Select the correct alternative and fill in the blanks in the following statements.
stem: A transversal intersects two parallel lines. If the measure of one of the angles is \(40^\circ\) then the measure of its corresponding angle is ............
_why: Corresponding angles formed by a transversal of two PARALLEL lines are congruent, so the corresponding angle is also 40 degrees. Option B is its supplement and C its complement - both are traps for confusing the angle pair.

subtopic: Use of Properties of Parallel Lines
context: Select the correct alternative and fill in the blanks in the following statements.
stem: In \(\Delta\)ABC, \(\angle\)A \(= 76^\circ\), \(\angle\)B \(= 48^\circ\), \(\therefore \angle\)C \(=\) ..............
_why: The sum of the measures of all angles of a triangle is 180 degrees, so \(\angle\)C \(= 180 - 76 - 48 = 56\) degrees. Option C is the sum of the two given angles and D is their difference.

context: Select the correct alternative and fill in the blanks in the following statements.
stem: Two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal. If the measure of one of the alternate interior angles is \(75^\circ\) then the measure of the other angle is ............
_why: Alternate interior angles formed by a transversal of two parallel lines are congruent, so the other angle is also 75 degrees. Option A is the supplement (which would be the interior angle on the SAME side) and B the complement.
